Here are some resources that can help: The National Drug Helpline: 1-800-662-HELP (4357) The Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA): https://www.samhsa.gov/find-help/national-helpline The National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA): https://www.drugabuse.gov/ Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA): https://www.dea.gov/
